description: Delivers the C# write-time checklist on the session's first edit of a compiled .cs file, advises (never denies) when a whole .cs file is read raw instead of located with search_index/get_symbol (including via Bash), refreshes the syntax index, live workspace and symbol store (via a loopback control channel) for every .cs file a tool just wrote, so an edit is queryable before the next call, and meters every tool call's request and response tokens so MCP and raw-tool routes are measured on one instrument. Every hook is a subcommand of the published server binary, so it runs wherever the .NET runtime the plugin already requires runs - no shell, no shebang, no jq/node/python3. The metering hook alone matches every tool (matcher "*"): it is the only one whose question is about tools it does not otherwise see, and it observes without ever withholding a call.
